annotations.title: Which inburgering exam do I need?

description: Explains which inburgering exams belong to a situation the user chose themselves from the official list (their DUO or municipality letter is the authority). Without an id: the list. With an id: the exams, who runs them, why, and official sources. It works from the situation the user picks and needs no details about their background or residence status.

situation.description: A situation id from the list, or a short description like 'naturalisation'.
